synth.notes:
Parse frame into 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks: axis row = most ring-10 blocks, any 11 = target, ring 5 = piece; selected piece grown from 0-centre blocks.
A1/A2 move selection one block row, A3/A4 one block col (axis rows only; A3/A4 on axis = no-op); blocked by board edge / other pieces. A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Reflections: piece blocks off the axis row mirror to row 2A-r as solid 4, skipping off-board and piece-covered dests; layers piece > refl > target > axis, centre = target 11 > selected-axis/piece 0 > refl 4 > 9.
HUD col 63 (64 cells, includes (63,63)): with n effective actions, rows < n-64 are 5, rows < n are 12, else 11. This was the step-63 fix: the 64th action fills (63,63) with 12. n is read back from the frame, so the rule is stateless.
